title: Glowing compass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='34' fill='#2b7a78'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='34' fill='none' stroke='#7fe0d4' stroke-width='3'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='27' fill='#0f2e33'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='27' fill='none' stroke='#4fd1c5' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- tick marks -->
  <g stroke='#6fe8dc' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='50' y1='27' x2='50' y2='32'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='72' x2='50' y2='77'/>
    <line x1='25' y1='52' x2='30' y2='52'/>
    <line x1='70' y1='52' x2='75' y2='52'/>
  </g>
  <!-- needle: north red, south white -->
  <polygon points='50,32 58,52 50,52' fill='#ff5a5a'/>
  <polygon points='50,32 42,52 50,52' fill='#ff9b9b'/>
  <polygon points='50,72 58,52 50,52' fill='#e8f9ff'/>
  <polygon points='50,72 42,52 50,52' fill='#a9d8e0'/>
  <!-- hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='2.2' fill='#8a5a00'/>
  <!-- glow highlights -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='36' r='3' fill='#c8fff6' opacity='0.75'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='29' fill='none' stroke='#7fe0d4' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
